statement: For the pinned Linux consumer, full input 0x30 and subcommand reply 0x21 carry the common timer, battery/connection field, button bytes and packed sticks; full input adds three six-axis IMU samples. Community Bluetooth notes describe the same field offsets and Bluetooth-oriented connection nibble. This does not prove retail timing, calibration, sensor accuracy or the exact Bluetooth descriptor.
